method: Independent implementation and newly authored acceptance fixtures; public documentation, installed-artifact metadata, focused private static inspection and ordinary unlicensed original CLI fixture runs inform behavioral requirements. No vendor source, binaries, fonts or license mechanisms are distributed in this repository.
status_policy: implemented means this entry's independent acceptance is supported by current tests/runtime and code evidence; partial means a verified slice exists with explicit remaining acceptance. Neither status means reference-product parity. planned means no sufficient implementation slice is tracked. All reference parity is NOT_PROVEN.
coverage_note: 144 grouped capability requirements plus a separate 416 named-filter acceptance ledger and 32 workflow contracts. Filter labels, configured slots, matching cells and engine fixtures never establish whole-feature parity. Full parity remains NOT_PROVEN.

project_constraints.implementation: Independent Rust implementation preferred by user
project_constraints.operation: Local operation; container/WSL/native launch packaging can be selected separately
project_constraints.url_limit: No commercial URL cap; user-configurable resource limits and physical hardware limits remain
project_constraints.third_party_services: Separate authorization, accounts, quotas and fees may be required; no credential or license bypass
project_constraints.compatibility: Open SEO Spider snapshot/config formats first. Compatibility with proprietary crawl files is not claimed.

phases.P1: HTTP crawler foundation and essential extraction
phases.P2: Persistence, graph analysis, relationships, sitemaps and analyst interface
phases.P3: Browser rendering, extraction and advanced validation
phases.P4: Authorized providers, optional AI, automation and MCP

features.name: Offline SERP editing
